A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PAGE-4D study and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables and appendices. Both contain 18 pages; the reference and appendix pages are visually identical.

before.justification: v6 reports original depth, camera-pose, point-reconstruction and rendering results, together with ablations and appendix analyses.

after.justification: v8 retains the original experimental results in Tables 1–5 and the masking, layer-perturbation and qualitative analyses in the appendix.

M1.justification: The architecture, masking mechanism, fine-tuning strategy and losses are retained. v8 explicitly names the training-only masking variant, but v6 Appendix 8.1 already describes retaining masking or removing it during the second training stage and providing both variants. The added wording clarifies inference behavior rather than establishing a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: The training mixture in Appendix 9/Table 8, five evaluation tasks, benchmark datasets and in-the-wild scenarios are unchanged. Highlighting the existing masking variant adds no dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within Tables 1–5, including Spann3R in camera-pose estimation and DAS3R in DyCheck point reconstruction. Table 7 also retains the same masking and layer-perturbation comparisons.

E3.justification: Depth alignment settings, Sim(3) trajectory alignment, 10-frame pose sampling, model configurations and training settings remain unchanged. No new or revised experimental protocol accompanies the masking-variant clarification.

E4.justification: Table 5's fine-tuning and masking ablations, Table 7's masking and layer-perturbation analyses, and the qualitative studies are retained. The observation that both masking strategies perform similarly already appears in v6 Appendix 8.1; v8 adds no supporting analysis.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests; the same point estimates and mean/median reconstruction summaries remain.

E6.justification: All matched result entries and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, PAGE-4D's Sintel scale-aligned depth Abs Rel remains 0.357 in Table 1 and its Sintel ATE remains 0.178 in Table 2. Comparable masking-variant performance was already reported qualitatively in v6 Appendix 8.1.

T1.justification: The geometry and epipolar equations, masked-attention formulation, memory-efficient attention derivation, multitask loss and appendix DD-MSK definition are retained. The added training-regularizer interpretation introduces no formal definition, derivation or proof.

C1.justification: v8 adds a fourth introduction contribution that elevates the existing training-only variant and claims comparable performance with VGGT's inference architecture and no additional inference overhead. The original task-performance claims and conclusion remain unchanged.

C2.justification: v8 newly interprets masking as an effective training-time regularizer for pose–geometry disentanglement whose benefits can persist without inference-time masking. v6 Appendix 8.1 reported similar variant performance without explicitly drawing this interpretation.

D1.justification: The abstract and Figure 3 caption now explicitly distinguish training-and-inference masking from training-only masking and identify the latter's VGGT architecture at inference. This clarifies the variants previously described in Appendix 8.1; the project link, hyperparameters and other implementation disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Related-work discussion, cited works and the reference list are unchanged. The masking clarification does not revise attribution or comparisons with prior research.

P1.justification: The title is rephrased, the abstract's closing code sentence is revised, and a fourth contribution bullet is added. Most prose and the section hierarchy remain unchanged, including the entire appendix.

P2.justification: Figure 3's caption is expanded and surrounding material reflows: Table 1 moves from page 7 to 8, Table 3 from 8 to 9, and Table 4 from 9 to 10. Figure content and table designs are retained.

improvement.justification: v8 makes the existing training-only masking option and its unchanged VGGT inference architecture explicit, improving clarity about deployment and the role of masking. The benefit is limited: v6 Appendix 8.1 already described both variants, and v8 adds no separate quantitative validation of their claimed comparable performance.
